AddServiceSharedAccounts.description_en: Adds shared accounts for a service
AddServiceSharedAccounts.description_zh: 调用AddServiceSharedAccounts新增服务的共享账号

ApproveServiceUsage.description_zh: 商家调用ApproveServiceUsage通过服务使用请求

ContinueDeployServiceInstance.description_en: Continues the deployment of a service instance after a deployment failure. You must specify the region ID, service ID, and the configuration parameters for the service instance
ContinueDeployServiceInstance.description_zh: 服务实例部署失败后，通过指定地域ID、服务ID、服务实例配置参数，继续部署服务实例

CreateOpsNotice.description_en: Creates an operations and maintenance (O&M) notice

CreateService.description_en: Creates a service by specifying parameters, such as the region ID, deployment type, service type, and service name
CreateService.description_zh: 通过地域ID、部署类型、服务类型、服务名称等参数，创建新的服务

CreateServiceInstance.description_en: You can create and deploy a service instance by specifying parameters such as the region ID, service ID, and service version
CreateServiceInstance.description_zh: 通过指定地域ID、服务ID、服务版本等参数，创建并部署服务实例

CreateServiceTestTask.description_en: Creates a test task for a service
CreateServiceTestTask.description_zh: 调用CreateServiceTestTask创建服务测试任务

CreateServiceUsage.description_en: You can create a service distribution request

DeleteAcrImageTags.description_en: Delete a container image version from ACR

DeleteArtifact.description_en: You can call DeleteArtifact to delete an artifact or a specific version of an artifact
DeleteArtifact.description_zh: 当您不再需要部署物或部署物对应版本，调用DeleteArtifact删除部署物

DeleteService.description_en: Deletes a specified service based on its region ID, service ID, and service version
DeleteService.description_zh: 通过地域ID、服务ID、服务版本删除指定服务

DeleteServiceInstances.description_en: Deletes service instances by specifying a region ID and service instance IDs
DeleteServiceInstances.description_zh: 通过指定地域ID、服务ID，删除服务实例

GenerateDefaultServiceTestConfig.description_en: You can call the GenerateDefaultServiceTestConfig operation to modify the service test configuration

GenerateServicePolicy.description_en: Queries the missing access policies before creating a service instance by calling GenerateServicePolicy
GenerateServicePolicy.description_zh: 调用GenerateServicePolicy创建服务实例前查询缺少的权限策略

GetArtifact.description_en: Retrieves the details of an artifact

GetArtifactRepositoryCredentials.description_en: Obtains the credentials required to upload an artifact
GetArtifactRepositoryCredentials.description_zh: 获取部署物上传所需的凭证

GetNetworkAvailableZones.description_en: Retrieves a list of available zones in a region
GetNetworkAvailableZones.description_zh: 根据地域参数获取地域可用区列表

GetOpsNotice.description_en: Queries the details of an O&M notice

GetService.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified service
GetService.description_zh: 调用GetService查询指定服务的详细信息

GetServiceEstimateCost.description_en: Retrieves the estimated cost of creating a service instance
GetServiceEstimateCost.description_zh: 查询创建服务实例的预估价格

GetServiceInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified service instance using the service instance ID and region ID. The returned information includes the deployment status, template name, and service details
GetServiceInstance.description_zh: 通过服务实例 ID、地域 ID查询指定服务实例的详细信息。例如，服务实例的部署状态、模板名称、服务详情等信息

GetServiceProvisions.description_en: Queries the activation status of a service and the information about its service roles
GetServiceProvisions.description_zh: 查询服务开通状态和服务角色信息

GetServiceRegistration.description_en: Queries the details of a service registration
GetServiceRegistration.description_zh: 获取服务审核申请详情

GetServiceTemplateCriterionIssues.description_en: Queries for criterion issues in a service template
GetServiceTemplateCriterionIssues.description_zh: 查询服务模板存在的规范问题

GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints.description_en: Queries the parameter constraints for a Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) template

GetServiceTestTask.description_en: After a service test task is created, you can call this API to retrieve the execution details of each use case in the task
GetServiceTestTask.description_zh: 当选择了不同的服务测试用例创建好服务测试任务后，可通过此API获取服务测试任务中每个用例执行的详细情况

GetUploadCredentials.description_en: Retrieves credentials to upload a file
GetUploadCredentials.description_zh: 获取上传文件的访问密钥

ListAcrImageRepositories.description_en: You can call the ListAcrImageRepositories operation to query a list of image repositories in ACR
ListAcrImageRepositories.description_zh: 调用ListAcrImageRepositories查看已上传至ACR的镜像列表

ListAcrImageTags.description_en: Lists the uploaded image versions in an image repository
ListAcrImageTags.description_zh: 调用ListAcrImageTags查看镜像仓库中已上传的镜像版本

ListArtifactBuildLogs.description_en: Queries the build logs of an artifact

ListArtifactRisks.description_en: Retrieves a list of security risks for an artifact
ListArtifactRisks.description_zh: 获取部署物安全风险列表

ListArtifactVersions.description_zh: 调用ListArtifactVersions查询部署物版本信息

ListOpsNotices.description_en: Queries the operations and maintenance (O&M) notices published by a service provider
ListOpsNotices.description_zh: 调用ListOpsNotices查询服务商发布过的运维公告

ListResellers.description_en: Queries a list of resellers for display on the frontend
ListResellers.description_zh: 查询分销商用于前端展示

ListServiceBuildLogs.description_en: Queries the logs for service instances, upgrades, and applications
ListServiceBuildLogs.description_zh: 查询部署实例、升级以及应用的日志

ListServiceInstanceBill.description_en: You can call the ListServiceInstanceBill operation to query the bills of a service instance
ListServiceInstanceBill.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceBill查询服务实例账单

ListServiceInstanceDeployDetails.description_en: Queries the deployment details for service instances
ListServiceInstanceDeployDetails.description_zh: 查询服务实例部署详情列表

ListServiceInstanceLogs.description_en: Call the ListServiceInstanceLogs operation to query deployment, upgrade, and application logs for a service instance
ListServiceInstanceLogs.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceLogs查询服务实例的部署，升级和应用等日志

ListServiceInstanceResources.description_en: Lists the resources in a service instance
ListServiceInstanceResources.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceResources查询服务实例包含的资源

ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory.description_en: You can call ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory to query the upgrade history of a service instance
ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory查询服务实例的升级历史

ListServiceInstances.description_en: Queries a list of service instances

ListServiceSharedAccounts.description_en: Queries the accounts that a service is shared with
ListServiceSharedAccounts.description_zh: 调用ListServiceSharedAccounts查看服务共享账号列表

ListServiceTestCases.description_en: Queries the service test cases for the current service version
ListServiceTestCases.description_zh: 列表查询当前服务版本下的服务测试用例集合

ListServiceTestTaskLogs.description_en: Retrieves the real-time logs of a service test
ListServiceTestTaskLogs.description_zh: 获取服务测试实时日志

ListServiceTestTasks.description_en: Queries the test tasks for a service
ListServiceTestTasks.description_zh: 调用ListServiceTestTasks查询服务模板测试信息

ListServiceUsages.description_en: Queries the usage of your services
ListServiceUsages.description_zh: 查看用户自己当前的服务使用申请

ListServices.description_en: Queries for a list of services based on specified parameters, such as a region ID and service IDs. The returned information includes the service status, service version, and publish time
ListServices.description_zh: 通过指定地域ID、服务ID等参数，查询服务信息列表。例如，服务状态，服务版本，发布时间等信息

ListSupplierRegistrations.description_zh: 查看服务商已经提交的入驻申请

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags of one or more resources

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values for a specific tag key
ListTagValues.description_zh: 查询标签键对应的标签值

ModifyServiceInstanceResources.description_en: Modifies the resources of a service instance
ModifyServiceInstanceResources.description_zh: 修改服务实例的资源信息

PushMeteringData.description_en: This API pushes metering data for pay-as-you-go Compute Nest service instances. The metering items must be predefined by the service provider
PushMeteringData.description_zh: 该API只支持推送按量付费的计算巢服务实例的计量数据，推送的计量项需要定义为服务商上报

RejectServiceUsage.description_en: You can call RejectServiceUsage to reject a service request

RestartServiceInstance.description_en: Call the RestartServiceInstance operation to restart a service instance whose status is Deployed
RestartServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Deployed（已部署）时，调用RestartServiceInstance接口重启服务实例

RollbackServiceInstance.description_en: Rolls back an upgraded service instance to its previous version
RollbackServiceInstance.description_zh: 对升级后的服务实例进行回滚，默认回滚到上一个升级版本

StartServiceInstance.description_en: Starts a service instance when its status is Stopped or StartFailed
StartServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Stopped（已关机）、StartFailed（开机失败）时，调用StartServiceInstance接口启动服务实例

StopServiceInstance.description_en: This operation stops a service instance that is in the Deployed or StopFailed state
StopServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Deployed（已部署）、StopFailed（关机失败）时，调用StopServiceInstance接口关闭服务实例

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to one or more resources
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为服务实例的资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UnTagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources删除服务实例资源的标签

UpdateServiceInstanceAttribute.description_en: Updates the attributes of a service instance

UpdateServiceInstanceSpec.description_en: Upgrades or downgrades a service instance

UpdateSharedAccountPermission.description_en: You can call UpdateSharedAccountPermission to update the permissions of a shared account
UpdateSharedAccountPermission.description_zh: 调用UpdateSharedAccountPermission更新共享账号的权限

UpdateSupplierInformation.description_en: You can call the UpdateSupplierInformation operation to update supplier information

UpgradeServiceInstance.description_en: The UpgradeServiceInstance operation upgrades a service instance based on parameters such as the region ID and service version
UpgradeServiceInstance.description_zh: 使用地域ID、服务版本等参数调用UpgradeServiceInstance升级服务实例
